label: D2 after choosing a2, early in the episode (trials < ~37)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and only when the action input is a2 (this trial chose a2; 10 of 57k activations otherwise). It is also strongly gated by time in the episode: rate ~15% of steps over trials 0-29, falling over 30-39, ~0 by 40-49 and exactly zero from trial 50 on, so it behaves like an elapsed-time / early-episode a2-choice detector (ep_trial is not an input, but the agent can track elapsed time in its hidden state; no FUTURE variables used). Predicate (D2, action==2, ep_trial<37) gives dev F1 0.86, mass recall 0.99; missed activations are tiny (1.1% of mass), mostly just past the cutoff. Magnitude: larger when the reached state is S2 (common after a2; ~0.8-1.0 of max) than S1 (rare; ~0.7), larger after a rewarded previous trial and on runs of repeated a2 choices, and it decays toward the end of its active window. Adding prev_action==2 or state==2 raises precision but costs a lot of recall. Does not fire after a1 choices, at D1/GO, or late in episodes.

issues: The core claims hold. On dev, the unit never fires outside D2: (phase != D2) has recall 0. It almost never fires at D2 after an a1 choice: 10 of 57,440 activations. (phase==D2)&(action==2) has recall 0.9998. Reported test scores reproduce: P 0.764, R 0.950, F1 0.847.

Systematic false-positive class: trials where the agent switches to a2 (stay==0, so prev_action==1). (phase==D2)&(action==2)&(ep_trial<37)&(stay==0) has precision 0.085 on dev (4,199 steps) and 0.099 on test (4,798 steps), with mass recall 0.003. So the unit does not fire when the agent switches to a2, which contradicts the label 'chose a2'. The explanation's note that activity is 'larger during runs of repeated a2 choices' understates this: on switch trials it is nearly silent.
Related: on the first a2 repeat right after a switch (stay==1 & tv('stay',-1)==0), precision is only 0.53. Activity builds over an a2 run rather than starting on the first a2 choice.
The unit never fires on episode trial 0 (ep_trial==0, a2, D2): 0 of 511 predicted steps. This is a small exception the label does not mention.

Remaining false positives cluster where S1 is the good state, meaning a2 is the bad choice (good==1, precision 0.51), and on start_high==1 episodes (precision 0.76 vs 0.86). So the unit also partly tracks a2 being the good choice, not just time in the episode. The label's 'early in the episode' cutoff partly stands in for this.

Improved predicate (all observed variables): (phase == D2) & (action == 2) & (ep_trial < 37) & (prev_action != 1) & (ep_trial > 0). It scores dev F1 0.885 (P 0.835, R 0.942) and test F1 0.875 (P 0.817, R 0.943, mass recall 0.986). That beats the original test F1 of 0.847.
skeptic.revised_label: D2 of a repeated a2 choice (not a switch to a2), early in the episode (trials 1 to about 36); stronger when S2 is good and after reward

final_label: D2 of a repeated a2 choice (not a switch to a2), early in the episode (trials 1 to about 36); stronger when S2 is good and after reward
